Athlete Keely Hodgkinson Wins Race in New Speedsuit

British athlete Keely Hodgkinson won her final race of the year wearing a new black speedsuit. She described feeling "little nervous" about wearing the new attire. The suit has been referred to as a "tornado" speedsuit.
